name: Odysseus landing site
coordinate_source: LRO/LROC NAC imaging (frame M1463440322L) reported by NASA and LROC: 80.13 S, 1.44 E, about 2,579 m elevation.
coordinate_note: Published to hundredths of a degree. The SPICE observer is placed at 0 m on the reference sphere; the published elevation is not used in the Sun/Earth geometry.
horizon_note: Odysseus has no terrain-horizon profile: its reported location is close to the 80 S coverage edge of the LOLA DEM used for Athena.

name: Athena landing site
coordinate_source: Rounded landed position. LROC (https://lroc.im-ldi.com/images/1408) gives 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E, about 22 m from these rounded coordinates.
coordinate_note: The rounded coordinates are kept because the LOLA horizon profile was generated for exactly this point. The 22 m offset is below the profile DEM's 80 m pixel size, but local terrain results may still change with the precise position.
